FIELDS.NAME: Secure Home Alarm Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Secure Home Alarm Solutions, we specialize in the installation and maintenance of state-of-the-art alarm systems designed to protect residential and commercial properties. Our operations include conducting comprehensive site assessments to evaluate security needs, followed by the meticulous installation of alarm systems that comply with all relevant NFPA standards. We ensure that all installations are overseen by certified technicians who receive regular fire safety training, maintaining a high standard of service and compliance.

We also provide ongoing system monitoring and maintenance services, ensuring that all alarm systems are regularly tested and inspected to guarantee reliability and effectiveness. Our commitment to safety is highlighted through a documented emergency response plan and periodic risk assessments, which help us identify vulnerabilities and enhance system performance.

Additionally, we maintain strong vendor relationships with reputable equipment manufacturers, ensuring that our clients receive top-quality products tailored to their security needs. Our track record of no major claims related to system failures or safety violations underscores our dedication to excellence in alarm system solutions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 15, 2023, a minor equipment malfunction in one of our alarm systems caused a temporary disruption in service, resulting in a response call from the local authorities. The incident was resolved promptly with no damage reported and the cost associated with the repair was $1,200. The situation has been addressed, and the system has since been inspected to ensure compliance and prevent future occurrences. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Security Safe, Class B, Grade 1
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Professional security fencing installed around the premises, complemented by a dedicated on-site security guard during operating hours to monitor and ensure safety."
